## History

Kenneth was a young boy who tragically died after falling off a large load of hay as it was being moved into a barn. His life was cut short when a wheel went directly over his small body during the accident.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P16](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0016)_
